clue.text: Steps taken over outdated weaponry

parts.note: dance steps performed above blades laid crossed on the floor, a Highland tradition

explanation.surface: A dry history of soldiers marching past obsolete arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steps' are dance steps, and the 'outdated weaponry' is the pair of blades laid on the ground that a Highland dancer steps over.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish solo display in which the performer steps nimbly between crossed blades on the floor.

clue.text: Man gets paving-block on his head

parts.note: a set (or sett) is a squared stone block used in paving

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word his

explanation.surface: A workman has a cobblestone dropped on him.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue SET sits 'on' H. Seth was the third son of Adam in Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical third son of Adam and Eve, a male name.

clue.text: One of 4 on a Mars trip

indicators.note: a trip suggests stumbling, so the letters of on a Mars fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A crew member of four astronauts heading for the red planet.
explanation.walkthrough: '4' is a coxless four, a racing boat with four rowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower, one of the crew of a racing four.

clue.text: Notes run on wheat product

parts.note: to double is to run, as in at the double
sharps are the fine middlings left after milling wheat

explanation.surface: Writings flow on about bread and cereal.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue DOUBLE goes 'on' top of SHARPS. A double sharp raises a note by two semitones.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical accidentals that raise a pitch by two semitones.

clue.text: They should be in the pink to get the blues

definitions.text: They should be in the pink to get the blues

parts.words: They should be in the pink to get the blues
parts.note: in the pink means in peak health, and a blue is the award for representing Oxford or Cambridge at sport

explanation.surface: Cheerful people ought to become depressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the blues' looks like sadness, but at Oxford and Cambridge a Blue is earned by competing for the university.
explanation.definitionFit: Sportspeople need peak fitness to win university honours.

clue.text: Many out of practice become irritable

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
rusty means having lost skill through lack of use

explanation.surface: Lots of people lose their edge and get bad-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: A crusty old person is gruff and short-tempered.

clue.text: Foster-parent in stupor?

parts.note: a foster-parent is a joint or co-mother, CO plus MA, and the whole is a deep unconsciousness

explanation.surface: A carer found dazed and senseless.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Foster-parent' as a co-mother, CO-MA; the result is the medical state of prolonged unconsciousness.
explanation.definitionFit: A prolonged state of deep unconsciousness is a stupor at its most extreme.

clue.text: Girl in OTC cooked ham, maybe

indicators.note: the girl's name goes inside the reworked letters
the letters of OTC are cooked up into a new order

parts.note: Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman in the Officers' Training Corps prepared some pork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges OTC to OCT. 'ham' is a verb: to perform too theatrically.
explanation.definitionFit: To ham is to perform with exaggeration, exaggerated acting.

clue.text: Absorb some courses in body-building?

definitions.meaning: to take in fully, as knowledge or food
meals taken in and digested so that the body grows

explanation.surface: Take in a few sessions at the gym.
explanation.walkthrough: 'courses' look like gym classes; they are courses of a meal, digested into the body.
explanation.definitionFit: To take in and digest, whether ideas or food converted into bodily tissue.

clue.text: Everywhere rejected, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the word for rejected is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: rejected means threw out

explanation.surface: Turned down on all sides, so the rumour goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Everywhere in a place means in every part of it, all over.

clue.text: Head of the loch?

parts.note: a headland is a head, and the most famous Scottish loch shares this name

explanation.surface: Who is in charge of the Scottish lake?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head' is a headland or promontory, not a chief; and Loch Ness is the famous Scottish lake bearing the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A promontory or headland, as in Scottish place names along coasts and lochs.

clue.text: Gas lighter — suitable present for motorist

definitions.text: Gas lighter — suitable present for motorist

parts.words: Gas lighter — suitable present for motorist
parts.note: gas here is the fuel mixture in an engine cylinder, ignited by an electric spark

explanation.surface: A cigarette lighter would make a nice gift for a driver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gas lighter' suggests a smoker's lighter, but it is the part that ignites fuel in a car engine.
explanation.definitionFit: The device screwed into a car engine's cylinder head that ignites the fuel-air mixture.

clue.text: Radical girl student

parts.note: Amy is a girl's name
L is a learner, as on the plates of a student driver

explanation.surface: A young woman at college with extreme politics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Radical' is the chemist's sense: a group of atoms acting as a unit, here the five-carbon group.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry a radical is a group of atoms; this is the pentyl group.

clue.text: Some spiritualistic matter?

parts.note: matter in the physical sense: the substance a medium is said to exude at a seance

explanation.surface: A topic of interest to believers in the spirit world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Matter' looks like 'subject', but it is the substance itself, said to issue from mediums.
explanation.definitionFit: The supposed viscous substance emitted by a medium in a trance at a seance.

clue.text: Blocks of theatre seats? Nothing new in that

indicators.note: the pieces for nothing and new go inside the word for theatre seats

parts.note: the stalls are the seats on a theatre's ground floor
O is nothing, the figure zero
taken as new

explanation.surface: Groups of seats in a theatre, none of them recently installed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blocks' is a verb: obstructs, as in cricket or politics.
explanation.definitionFit: To obstruct by delaying tactics, as a batsman or politician does.

clue.text: Metal in first of tommy guns distributed — number given

indicators.note: takes only the opening letter of the word tommy
the letters of guns are spread around into a new order

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: A soldier's weapons made of steel are handed out with a count.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributed' rearranges GUNS to UNGS.
explanation.definitionFit: Wolfram is a hard grey element used in lamp filaments, a metal.

clue.text: Inhuman nevertheless about right to the Italian

indicators.note: the word for nevertheless goes around the letter for right

parts.note: but means nevertheless
al is Italian for 'to the'

explanation.surface: A cruel act, though it was correct for the man from Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cruel and savage behaviour lacks humane feeling.

clue.text: Laws give conditions to carry out, nothing less

indicators.note: the word for conditions holds the shortened word inside it

parts.note: states means conditions

indicators.note: the letter for nothing is taken away from the word out

parts.note: O is nothing, zero

explanation.surface: Legislation lays down terms to be enforced to the letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'give' is only a link here; 'to carry' is the container signal and 'less' the deletion, so 'out, nothing less' is read as one unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Written acts passed by a legislature are laws.

clue.text: Barbarian holds everyone back in ravine

indicators.note: the whole assembled run of letters is read from the end
the word for barbarian contains the word for everyone

parts.note: a Hun was one of the barbarian invaders of Rome
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A savage keeps a crowd at bay in a gorge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the whole assembly, not just one piece. A nullah is an Anglo-Indian word met in tales of the Raj.
explanation.definitionFit: An Anglo-Indian word for a dry riverbed or gully, a ravine.

clue.text: Features of services perhaps disliked in some form

definitions.meaning: readings from the Bible in a church service
school classes unloved by some pupils in a school year group, a form

explanation.surface: Elements of church worship that some people find distasteful.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'form' is a British school class or year group.
explanation.definitionFit: Bible readings in church; also school classes, often unpopular with pupils.

clue.text: Harsh red tints mixed

indicators.note: the letters of red tints are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: Garish reddish shades blended together.
explanation.definitionFit: A strident voice is loud and grating, so harsh to hear.

clue.text: End of late meter collector

annotationWithheld.why: End of late meter collector (7): EX (late) is clear, but no reading of 'meter collector' gives TREME

clue.text: Point to bull-ring of the prevailing type

parts.note: W is west, a point of the compass
the inner is the ring of a target next to the bull's-eye

explanation.surface: Aim at the arena where bulls fight, typical of the times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bull-ring' looks like a bullfighting arena; on a dartboard or target the inner ring surrounds the bull.
explanation.definitionFit: One who prevails comes first in a contest.

clue.text: It's found in the compass of US army training

definitions.meaning: one of the cardinal markings on a compass card, facing sunset
the US Military Academy in New York State, where army officers train

explanation.surface: Where in the region do American soldiers learn their trade?
explanation.definitionFit: The cardinal direction opposite east marks a compass; it also names the American military academy on the Hudson.

clue.text: Germanic tribesman became hated leader

parts.note: got means became, as in got angry

explanation.surface: A warrior from the north who turned into a loathed chief.
explanation.definitionFit: One of an ancient Germanic people who invaded the Roman Empire.

clue.text: Gun fired in the first engagement?

annotationWithheld.why: Gun fired in the first engagement? (4) held as ETEN: no parse gives these letters
annotationWithheld.clue: Gun fired in the first engagement?

clue.text: See to return of plunder

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold

indicators.note: the word to is turned to run backwards

explanation.surface: Arrange for stolen goods to be given back.
explanation.definitionFit: Plunder is goods taken by force, booty or spoils.

clue.text: £1,000 note in second payment

indicators.note: the pieces for money and the note go inside the word for second

parts.note: an instant is a second, a moment
L stands for pound (libra) and M is Roman for a thousand
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A thousand-pound banknote paid out as the next part of a debt.
explanation.definitionFit: One of a series of part-payments made over time on a hire purchase.

clue.text: Pole has reorganized the band

parts.note: S is the south pole

indicators.note: the letters of has are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A man from Poland has shaken up the musical group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a Polish person; it is a magnetic pole, S. 'reorganized' turns HAS into ASH.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of fabric worn over the shoulder or round the waist is a band.

clue.text: The shade we find in the meadow

definitions.text: The shade we find in the meadow

parts.words: The shade we find in the meadow
parts.note: shade means a colour, not shadow: the hue of a field's turf

explanation.surface: Where we sit out of the sun in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shade' suggests shadow under a tree, but it is a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright fresh colour like that of lawn or pasture turf.
